decision: No feasibility witness and no infeasibility proof. Keep the approach unpromoted; neither search redesign nor template-family rejection is justified by this run alone.
scope: Diagnostic-only independent finite-domain solver on exactly the captured three-output topology and frozen templates. No production or frozen-experiment modifications.

policy.scope: Diagnostic-only feasibility of the unchanged captured three-output topology and complete template domains. Not an original-budget control result.
policy.solver: OR-Tools CP-SAT, exactly one Boolean per distinct statically legal complete path, lazy exact cell-occupancy exclusions
invariants: Enumerate every frozen domain candidate; do not shorten domains or change geometry.
Collapse only identical normalized complete paths belonging to the same obligation, retaining a representative frozen candidate ID.
Cross-check static rejection against independent expanded-cell geometry; disagreement invalidates the diagnostic, never proves infeasibility.
Collision cuts exclude only simultaneous selections occupying a cell they cannot legally share under exact endpoint ownership.
A relaxed-model witness is not accepted until all selected paths pass independent complete geometry checks.
Only CP-SAT INFEASIBLE after complete domain enumeration and sound exclusions proves frozen-family infeasibility. Any diagnostic limit is UNKNOWN.

Any witness is separately replayed through the existing construction/audit path with exact problem equality, in a temporary extracted archive. It cannot open production or downstream experiment gates.

independent_static_checks: Every enumerated candidate was checked against the independent expanded-cell oracle, or collapsed into an identical already-checked legal path in the same obligation. Zero disagreements.

solver.interpretation: OPTIMAL in intermediate rounds means feasibility of the incomplete relaxation, not collision-free template feasibility. Each rejected assignment added only exact shared-cell exclusions.

reporting_failure.failure: The one-shot deadline alarm interrupted final timer cancellation before result.json was written.
reporting_failure.recovery: Classification is explicitly recovered from the saved solver checkpoint and execution traceback, not presented as an originally emitted final result.
reporting_failure.fix: Catch the pending one-shot deadline exception while disarming for evidence finalization.
reporting_failure.verified: Real SIGALRM injection reproduces missing evidence before the fix and successful UNKNOWN evidence flush after it.

reproduction.command: From the project root, after extracting this reproduction archive: PYTHONPATH=src .venv/bin/python <extract>/probe.py <extract>/frozen-reproduction.zip <fresh-output-directory>
reproduction.versions: Project Python 3.14 environment and existing OR-Tools 9.15.6755 dependency; no dependency added.
reproduction.runtime_scope: 180 seconds for capture, full domain preparation and solver; only a valid complete geometry witness triggers the separate 60-second diagnostic acceptance audit.
reproduction.reproducibility_limit: The worker count and seed are fixed, but a wall-time cutoff does not guarantee identical round counts on another run.
reproduction.original_probe_and_checkpoint: initial-run-evidence.zip preserves the exact executed source and its hashes. Top-level probe.py includes only the subsequent alarm-finalization repair.

claim_limits: No frozen-template-family or factory infeasibility proof.
No factory acceptance audit was invoked without a witness.
No production-budget result or downstream gate acceptance.
No deadline extension or feasibility-search restart after UNKNOWN.
